purpose: Four worker style approval previews. These are raster references, not 3D models or tested code renders.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: worker character style approval preview for an interactive cafe construction simulator.
Create ONE separate square image showing exactly ONE full-body construction worker. Consistent comparison setup: elevated three-quarter orthographic camera, looking down about 35 degrees, front and right side visible. The figure faces slightly toward screen right, standing relaxed with feet apart, a small simplified hammer hanging down in the right hand. Entire body and helmet visible with generous margins, centered, occupying about 70% of image height. Plain warm off-white background and one simple light-gray square floor tile under the feet. No room or cafe, no additional objects.
Identical outfit across the style comparison: ochre-yellow safety hard hat, orange safety vest with two plain light strips, dark navy work shirt and trousers, charcoal work boots, brown tool belt with two simple pouches. Light-medium skin. Adult worker.
The intended result must look feasible as a simple game character, with clear shapes and readable tools. Do not make cinematic concept art. No text, captions, labels, logos, watermark, montage, multiple views, or extra characters.
STYLE 1 — GENUINE TWO-DIMENSIONAL ISOMETRIC PIXEL ART: nostalgic Habbo-like room-game character, not a 3D render and not voxel sculpture. A crisp low-resolution sprite designed on approximately a 128 by 128 pixel working grid, enlarged with nearest-neighbor so every pixel has clean hard square edges. Limited flat palette, dark pixel outlines, simple two-tone shading, chunky readable head, small torso, short articulated legs, extremely simple face. Floor tile drawn in isometric pixel art. No antialiasing, gradients, smooth surfaces, blur, realistic lighting, or photographic detail. Keep the hammer and outfit recognizable with very few pixels.

STYLE 2 — SIMPLE BLOCK-BASED 3D WORKER: a deliberately basic real-time 3D game figure constructed entirely from rectangular cuboids. Box head, box torso, straight rectangular upper arms and forearms, square mitten hands without fingers, rectangular legs and block boots. Boxy stepped safety helmet with a flat rectangular brim. Compact toy proportions about 4 heads tall. All silhouette edges are square and angular, no spherical head, no cylinders, no rounded capsule limbs. Solid flat material colors, no texture maps, simple soft ambient light and modest contact shadow. Orange vest represented by flat colored geometric pieces. Clearly visible separate rigid limb pieces that can rotate at joints. Simple painted dot eyes. Feels like a tasteful basic block toy that can be built directly in code, not a detailed LEGO product.
